title: Constructed quotient module of consecutive nilradical powers is quasi-coherent
statement: Let X be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] and N its nilradical. Let M(I)=I.toModules denote the actual kernel of O_X→(V(I)→X)_*O_V(I) in X.Modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The inclusion N^(j+2)⊆N^(j+1) from [lem-sc-reduction-units-power-inclusion] induces the standard module inclusion toModulesOfLE. Define F_j=coker(M(N^(j+2))→M(N^(j+1))) in X.Modules. For every j≥0 this specific F_j is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], without Noetherian or nilpotence bounds.

source.place: Proof, Step 1 and the following Claim; proof text retained in the parent DAG node

proof.text: The module M(I) is the categorical kernel of O_X→i_*O_V(I). Both structure modules are quasi-coherent. A closed immersion is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh makes its pushforward quasi-coherent. The quasi-coherent kernel theorem makes M(I) quasi-coherent.
Use the real toModulesOfLE morphism for the ideal-power inclusion and define F_j as its cokernel. Apply quasi-coherent cokernel closure to the two ideal modules.
